summary: Postal Realty Trust disclosed on Form 8-K that it closed, effective September 4, 2026, the acquisition of a 72-property USPS-leased portfolio from entities affiliated with CEO Andrew Spodek for approximately $27.75 million, excluding costs and adjustments. Consideration comprised $25.75 million cash and $2.0 million of Postal Realty LP OP Units, settled as 85,300 units based on a $23.4465 ten-day VWAP. Spodek beneficially owned 50% of the portfolio and received about $11.88 million cash plus all OP units. A special committee of four independent directors approved the transaction; Spodek recused himself. The 100%-occupied portfolio spans roughly 148,374 net leasable square feet at a $14.71 weighted average rent per square foot. The deal was not subject to the existing right of first offer agreement. Watch related-party optics, unit dilution, and potential valuation scrutiny given the CEO's dual role.
